title: The passive (present and past)
en:
Passive = be + past participle. We use it when the action or result is more important than the person who does it: The report is checked by the manager. The plant was built in 1945.

Present: am / is / are + participle · Past: was / were + participle.

Add by only if it is important who did it: The contract was signed by the director.

Very common in processes and procedures: Invoices are received, checked and approved before payment.
ru: Пассив: be + 3-я форма. Настоящее — am/is/are + V3 (is checked), прошедшее — was/were + V3 (was built). by — кем сделано (только если важно). Часто в описании процессов и процедур.

boss.situation: Describe a work process in the passive: how a document is prepared, checked and approved. Add one sentence in the past passive.
samples: First, the purchase request is prepared by the department.
Then it is checked by the procurement team.
The budget is confirmed by the finance department.
Finally, the contract is signed by the director.
Last year the procedure was updated after an audit.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “The report is check every week.”
a: The report is checked every week.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “The bridge was build in 1990.”
Correct the mistake: “The letters was sent yesterday.”
